frame: Origin at the center of the east-facing arcade and corner pavilions. X north-northwest along the court facade, Y west-southwest through the hall, Z up.
plan_basis: Aerial roof bounds approximately 26.5 by 19.3m, square-ish hall with two projecting front corner pavilions; geometric roof centers aligned with the western and northern lot edges, reducing relief displacement. Height and depth follow public proportions; no measured survey is available. The 6.4 m coarse lot height includes the adjacent low ranges.
remaining: 东附翼、南房、街门、净身堂及24号女寺另列。
roof_finial_evidence: The 2014-11-16 roof view shows an open light-coloured pavilion, shallow gold ribs, a bulb below a long slim rod, and a small crescent. The gold apex to crescent spans about one canopy width in this view.
west_projection: The OSM lot bends outward by roughly 2.7 m on the west centreline. Only its exterior ground projection and wall are modeled; interior form is undocumented.
